name: saprophytic
source:
Astrodyne Academy is a prestigious university with a rich history as a castle stronghold during the Draconic Calamity. In recent years, it's become globally renowned for its research accolades in the arcane arts and sciences. 

Less importantly, over a year ago, a witch named Atlas Morningstar dropped out of Astrodyne Academy. Only just this fall, have they returned for the new school year with a  new look,  a new glint in their eyes, and a  new mysterious tome latched onto their belt.

An Astrodyne Academy side story about two strangers sharing a meal together.

[From [url=https://surejanel.itch.io/saprophytic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿斯特罗达因学院是一所享有盛誉的大学，拥有丰富的历史，在龙之灾难期间作为城堡要塞。近年来，它因其在神秘艺术和科学领域的研究荣誉而享誉全球。

不太重要的是，一年多前，一位名叫阿特拉斯·晨星的女巫从阿斯特罗达因学院退学。就在今年秋天，他们以新的面貌、新的眼神、新的神秘书卷系在腰带上迎接新学年。

阿斯特罗达因学院的支线故事，讲述两个陌生人一起吃饭的故事。

[来自[url=https://surejanel.itch.io/saprophytic]itch.io[/url]]
